about: Golden cases for the app board's columns (server-spec/app-board.md; check AB1). `mapping` is the profile's app_columns or null for the default; `expect` maps each Status (null counts as empty) to its column. Mapping cases give a mapping and expect ok.

cases.name: default-table
cases.what: each Status of the gtd-dispatch board maps as the story says

cases.name: unmapped-is-other
cases.what: a Status with no mapping is other, never dropped

cases.name: no-status-is-other
cases.what: an item with no Status is other

cases.name: case-and-space
cases.what: options match without regard to case or extra spaces

cases.name: profile-mapping
cases.what: a profile's own mapping replaces the default

mapping_cases.name: mapping-ok
mapping_cases.what: a mapping onto the five columns is valid

mapping_cases.name: mapping-bad-column
mapping_cases.what: a mapping onto a column that does not exist is refused

mapping_cases.name: mapping-to-other
mapping_cases.what: other is the fallback, not a target

mapping_cases.name: mapping-empty
mapping_cases.what: an empty mapping is refused (omit it for the default)
